skills.name: hoi-3d-map
skills.description: Open the local HOI Workspace App or its optional 3D knowledge map to inspect source-backed search, wiki, memory, entities, relationships, and temporal views.

skills.name: hoi-audit
skills.description: Inspect an HOI OS workspace for schema, database, extraction, backup, adapter, connection, workflow, and memory health without changing it.

skills.name: hoi-build-capability
skills.description: Define, evaluate, and activate a bounded HOI workflow using registered tools.

skills.name: hoi-capture
skills.description: Record user-supplied decisions, preferences, or experience as reviewable HOI memory.

skills.name: hoi-connect
skills.description: Check available Gmail, Calendar, Drive, or GitHub host tools for a selected HOI workspace.

skills.name: hoi-consolidate
skills.description: Find duplicate, stale, and proposed HOI memories for review.

skills.name: hoi-evaluate
skills.description: Run reproducible evidence retrieval checks for a HOI capability.

skills.name: hoi-ingest
skills.description: Plan and ingest selected local files or authorized host exports into HOI OS with bounded scope, preserved originals, provenance, and visible failures.

skills.name: hoi-install
skills.description: Install or update HOI OS from its official GitHub release in a local Codex or Claude Code workspace, or guide a ChatGPT or Claude chat user through local installation.

skills.name: hoi-meeting-prep
skills.description: Prepare a cited client meeting brief using HOI knowledge and available read-only host connections.

skills.name: hoi-onboard
skills.description: Onboard a user into HOI OS, capture their operating context, select a bounded source scope, and reach a first useful result without uncontrolled ingestion.

skills.name: hoi-organize
skills.description: Propose and apply an exact, approval-bound organization of HOI OS working copies while preserving every original.

skills.name: hoi-retrieve
skills.description: Find source-backed information and bounded context in HOI OS.

skills.name: hoi-session-capture
skills.description: Propose reviewable HOI memories and wiki updates from decisions made in the current working session.

skills.name: hoi-wiki
skills.description: Build and maintain cited, reviewable current-view wiki pages from HOI OS evidence without replacing original sources or history.
